earPiercing.title: Ear piercing
earPiercing.text: We use the Studex System 75 instrument set. It provides a precise, fast and quiet application of earrings made of surgical steel. We only pierce the earlobes of registered infants, by prior appointment. The condition is a healthy earlobe and surrounding area, and enough time after the first tetanus vaccination so the child already has protective antibodies. Parents can choose basic earrings with a plain stud, which are exchanged for their own earrings once the wound has healed, or earrings with a decorative flower (the current selection will be shown before the application).

vaccinationSchedule.title: The child vaccination schedule provides a simple and concise overview of mandatory and optional reimbursed vaccinations for children in the Czech Republic. The clear table lists both the different types of vaccinations and the number of doses that must be administered for the vaccinated child to be protected against infection. The schedule includes mandatory reimbursed vaccinations, recommended reimbursed vaccinations, and recommended non-reimbursed vaccinations.

rows.mandatoryDisease: Tuberculosis (only for at-risk children with indication) #

rows.age: From the start of week 9 (2 months)
rows.mandatoryDisease: Diphtheria, tetanus, pertussis, poliomyelitis, viral hepatitis B, diseases caused by Haemophilus influenzae type b
rows.mandatoryVaccine: Hexavalent vaccine: Infanrix Hexa, Hexacima – dose 1 *

rows.mandatoryDisease: Diphtheria, tetanus, pertussis, poliomyelitis, viral hepatitis B, diseases caused by Haemophilus influenzae type b
rows.mandatoryVaccine: Hexavalent vaccine: Infanrix Hexa, Hexacima – dose 2 *

rows.mandatoryDisease: Diphtheria, tetanus, pertussis, poliomyelitis, viral hepatitis B, diseases caused by Haemophilus influenzae type b
rows.mandatoryVaccine: Hexavalent vaccine: Infanrix Hexa, Hexacima – dose 3 *
Tdap-IPV vaccine: Boostrix polio, Adacel Polio (booster)

footnotes: # Including a tuberculin test performed when a child older than 6 weeks needs to be vaccinated; in that case, vaccination is carried out only if the tuberculin test is negative. This applies to at-risk groups of children.

* For premature infants, vaccination is carried out with three doses of vaccine given at intervals of at least one month between doses, followed by a fourth dose given at least 6 months after the third dose (i.e. the 3+1 schedule).
** Against invasive meningococcal disease caused by meningococcus group B, if vaccination is started before the age of 12 months.

*** For premature infants, vaccination is carried out with three doses of vaccine given at intervals of at least one month between doses, followed by a fourth dose given at least 6 months after the third dose (i.e. the 3+1 schedule).
**** Against invasive meningococcal disease groups A, C, W, Y, if vaccination is given as a single dose between the 1st and 2nd birthday.

¤ Against invasive meningococcal disease caused by meningococcus group B, if vaccination is given as a single dose between the 14th and 15th birthday. Vaccination is reimbursed if started at this age.
¤¤ Against invasive meningococcal disease groups A, C, W, Y, if vaccination is given as a single dose between the 14th and 15th birthday.
Adapted from Decree No. 537/2006 Coll., on vaccination against infectious diseases, as amended, and Act No. 48/1997 Coll., on public health insurance, as amended.
